y99fk6.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
y99fk6.description_zh:

特别是，我们在 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

1g9jlt9.description_en:
Congrats on completing part two of this eight-part course.
The third scenario throws tactical considerations into the mix. This time around the attacking ships are from distinct classes with distinct battlefield applications. Knowing what targets to prioritize is vital to surviving engagements against multiple ships.
Whenever you’re ready, head to [LOCATION] to get started.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 5 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Bigger They Are – Try to evaluate which threat is the most dangerous and take them out first.
- Shields – If you’re taking a lot of damage, don’t be afraid to boost away and let your shields regenerate.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

准备就绪后，请前往 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 开始训练。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 <EM4>[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证</EM4>。

实战技巧：
- 擒贼先擒王 - 优先评估最具威胁的目标并集中消灭。
- 护盾管理 - 若持续遭受重创，不妨加速脱离战场等待护盾充能。

祝你好运，
教练吉利

1mkonrh.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Update:
Reviewing Dr. Jorrit’s recent files that you uploaded to me left us with more questions than answers. While we know for a fact that the doctor had been inside Onyx, we don’t yet know the specifics of what he was doing. The client is eager for us to learn more about what exactly Jorrit’s up to, so I’m afraid you’re going to have to go back in.
I have a few ideas on how we might be able to use the facility’s systems to pinpoint Dr. Jorrit’s activities, though you’ll have to physically bring me the data this time so we can properly analyze it. First up, are the energy sensors in Engineering. They’re still active and sensitive enough to pick up any anomalous readings.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and retrieve the Energy Anomaly data and deliver it to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:

p2ktgz.description_en:
Recently, a [TARGET] baited Foxwell forces with a bogus rescue beacon. By the time our forces realized what was happening, a squad of ships unleashed a devastating attack and only one Foxwell contractor survived. Their scan logs identified the bait ship, and we’ve had scouts monitoring them ever since.
Our surveillance has revealed the squad has a regular flight pattern that we think we can exploit. There’s a sizable emission cloud at [LOCATION] that makes it an ideal spot to post up. Think you have what it takes to handle this for us?
It’ll be you against the [TARGET], other large craft, and a sizable escort. Wish I could be more specific than that but this crew regularly rotates ships in and out of the squad. Would be smart to bring some support, so you don’t get overwhelmed by their numbers.
Complete the job and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
p2ktgz.description_zh:
最近，<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> 用一个假救援信标诱捕了福克斯韦尔的部队。当我们的部队意识到发生了什么时，一支飞船小队发起了毁灭性的攻击，只有一名福克斯韦尔的承包商幸存下来。他们的扫描日志识别出了诱饵船，从那时起我们就有侦察员在监视他们。

我们的监视显示这支小队有一个规律的飞行路线，我们认为可以加以利用。在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 处有一片巨大的辐射云，非常适合我们设伏。你觉得自己能处理好这一切吗？

1bsv6na.description_en:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx
DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.
While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.
Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.
TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.
Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
1bsv6na.description_zh:
合约：采矿权转让
地点：尼克斯星系

详情：
舒宾星际的勘探者们最近发现了一处已被废弃的 QV 行星服务公司碎岩站的位置，该站位于基格小行星带附近。这些站点最初由这家已倒闭的公司用来从小行星内部开采珍贵资源，但其确切位置早已丢失多年。

虽然该站点目前处于离线状态，但我们的侦察队认为，只要进行必要的维修，它就能重新投入使用。此外，一旦将其恢复运行，现场已经有一块富含资源的小行星，随时可以由站点的采矿激光进行开采。

不幸的是，由于在尼克斯运营面临的各种挑战，舒宾手头目前没有足够的宽裕自行处理上述维修工作。但这却为像您这样对独立采矿作业感兴趣的人创造了一个机会。

<EM4>条款*:</EM4>
我们提供该 QV 碎岩站站的<EM4>共享采矿权</EM4>。购买后，我们将向您及您的船员提供该站点的坐标。（请注意，任何其他有兴趣购买采矿权的人也将获得该站点的访问权限。）随后，您的船员可驾驶<EM4>采矿飞船</EM4>前往该地点，将<EM4>该空间站的采矿激光</EM4>恢复至运行状态，开采小行星，并在内部<EM4>获取资源</EM4>。

请注意，由于这是一份共享合约，所以我们能够以较低的价格提供这些采矿权，但小行星中的资源将与现场的其他采矿人员按<EM4>先到先得</EM4>的原则共享。此外，其他感兴趣的各方（如不法分子）也有可能自行发现该空间站的位置。请务必谨慎行事。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Combat Ships w/Ordnance
Briefing:
Local assets have indicated that Shattered Blade elements are attempting to rebuild one of their stations and Intersec is looking for a pilot to make sure that doesn't happen.
They've managed to get basic turret defenses back online but currently only have two power relays activated. These will be your targets as they cannot be destroyed by energy weapons, you will need to bring ballistic or ordnance to be effective.
Reactivation of this station will allow the Shattered Blade to try and reclaim a foothold in this system and we can't let that happen.
Good luck,
Deacon Tobin

1haupa6.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of three resources essential for their experiments: saldynium, jaclium, and carinite.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
Though we haven’t been able to do thorough scans, there’s a strong belief among our teams that Hathor’s defunct Orbital Laser Platforms were built above areas with a high concentration of these resources. Reactivating these OLP could be your best hope of acquiring what we need.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
1haupa6.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏三种对实验至关重要的资源：<EM4>烁迪银, 杰金, 和 科力晶</EM4> 而受阻。

特别是，我们在 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

尽管我们尚未进行彻底扫描，但我们的团队坚信，哈索尔已经废弃得轨道激光平台建造在这些资源浓度较高的区域之上。重新激活这些轨道激光平台可能是获取我们所需资源的最佳希望。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包
